text:
Type: glass globe ceiling lamp
Use: general light on a ceiling or wall; hallway, entryway, bedroom, bathroom
Style: classic, traditional, farmhouse
Materials: glossy white porcelain mount, opal white glass globe
Colors: glossy white, milky white glass
Shape: round ball shade below a bell-shaped glossy mount, sits close to the ceiling or wall, compact and simple, light visual weight
Feel: clean, classic, soft, simple
Goes with: white walls, subway tile, light wood, brass or chrome accents; farmhouse, classic or traditional hallways and bathrooms

product.name: VITEMLLA
product.description: Gives a diffused light; good for spreading light into larger areas of a bathroom.
